title: 第十七章 人世蜉蝣感谢不是老狗的盟主第十八章 灾祸之器感谢viburnia的盟主
lines: 离开病房之后，闻雯实际上并没有走远，只是上了两层楼，拐了个弯，就进了空荡荡的会议室。
童画趴在桌子上，睡得不省人事，鼾声响起，怀里还抱着好几本档案，明显不知道熬了多少个大夜。
至于熬夜是为了上分还是干活儿，那可就……有待商榷了。
砰！
闻雯毫不客气的一拳砸在桌子上，把摸鱼睡觉的下属震醒了。
“怎么了？怎么了？”
童画警觉的抓起手机，“谁放的大？”
黑黝黝的熄灭屏幕上并没有游戏画面，只是映照出童画身后那一张面无表情的面孔，弯下腰来，凑近了，在耳边，温柔提醒：
“下次你再熬夜，我就把你手机撅了，知道吗？”
“我没睡，我醒着的，我醒了！”
童画抹了把脸，努力装作容光焕发的样子，然后更凸显出两个黑眼圈。
献宝一样，举起手里的档案。
“都查清楚了。”
“那就说说看吧。”
闻雯翻检着手里的档案，问道：“都是些什么来历。”
“带头的几個，昨晚你问的那个女人，叫做祝虹，三十一岁。”
童画只是摸了一把档案，一切都了然于胸：“明面上是两家连锁餐饮和KTV的经营者，实际上只是挂名。
她真正的身份是泉乡联谊会……恩，就是道儿上说的泉城帮二把手的情妇，据说曾经做过陪酒公关之类的工作，后面报上了陈行舟的大腿之后，勾搭上了现在的姘头……不过她那个姘头，玩得真的挺变态，算了，都不重要。
反正祝虹染上血渴症之后，第一个吃的就是他，后面的你就知道了，一发不可收拾，把自己的小姐妹和闺蜜都快吃完了。
短短两个星期，就达到了第五期的程度，肢体异化，生命形式变更，完全变成了孽化物种，抵达到了这一步，已经称得上是异变型食尸鬼了。
目前崖城的感染者里，有一多半都是她传染的，顺着这条线我和小安、老张忙了一宿，逮了二十多个回来！”
忽略掉‘我们几个嘎嘎乱杀’这句话里的水分，闻雯直截了当的问道：“怎么处理的？”
“按照雯姐你的规定，吃过人的一律干掉，还没到第三阶段的送去疗养院那边，强制性的治疗，钱走的还是公司的账，具体的花销在这里……”
那几本账单，闻雯看都没看一眼，只是随意的丢在了旁边。
“还有么？”
“还有就是，你说的那位名言哥，咳咳，唔，季觉同学所说的，跑到他家袭击他的老头儿，状况也调查出来了，在这里。”
童画翻了半天，找出了两页纸，推过来。
轻飘飘的一生。
陈炉生，男，七十一岁，拾荒者。
年轻的时候游手好闲，好勇斗狠做混混，老婆跟人跑了都不管，后面老娘死了之后，终于痛改前非，可惜晚了。
除了帮工和力气活儿，没地方肯要他。
泥瓦工、搬砖、修下水，基本上市面的行当都干过，上了年纪之后，攒了点钱，搞了个废品站，也收冰箱彩电，倒腾着卖钱，勉强度日。
这就是一个底层人的平淡一生，乏善可陈。
直到……他在垃圾堆里捡到了一个小孩儿。
有遗传病，浑身溃烂，手指都被老鼠咬掉了好几根，所有人都说养不活了，就只有越来越沉默寡言的老头儿一声不吭的陪着她熬了一整个冬天，彼此相伴。
熬过来了。
但又没能熬太久。
content_en:
After leaving the ward, Wen Wen actually didn't go far. She just went up two floors, turned a corner, and entered the empty conference room.
Tong Hua was lying on the table, sleeping unconsciously, snoring loudly, and holding several files in his arms. It was obvious that he had stayed up many nights.
As for whether staying up late is to improve grades or to do work, that's... open to debate.
Bang!
Wen Wen punched the table unceremoniously, waking up his sleeping subordinates.
"What's wrong? What's wrong?"
Tong Hua grabbed the phone alertly, "Who magnified it?"
There was no game screen on the dark black screen, it just reflected the expressionless face behind Tong Hua. He bent down, got closer, and gently reminded in his ear:
"Next time you stay up late, I'll put your phone away, do you understand?"
"I'm not asleep, I'm awake, I'm awake!"
Tong Hua wiped his face, trying to pretend to be radiant, and then highlighted the two dark circles under his eyes.
Like offering a treasure, he raised the file in his hand.
"Everything has been checked."
"Then let's talk about it."
Wen Wen looked through the files in her hand and asked, "What are their origins?"
"The leading ones, the woman you asked about last night is called Zhu Hong, thirty-one years old."
Tong Hua just touched the file and everything became clear: "On the surface, he is the operator of two chain restaurants and KTV, but in fact it is just in name.
Her true identity is that of the Quanxiang Sorority... Well, she is the mistress of the second-in-command of the Quancheng Gang as mentioned in the Taoist. It is said that she once worked as a public relations escort. After she reported to Chen Xingzhou's thigh, she hooked up with her current mistress... But that mistress of hers was really perverted in her behavior. Forget it, it doesn't matter.
Anyway, after Zhu Hong contracted blood thirst, he was the first one to eat. You will know later that he got out of control and almost finished eating his little sisters and best friends.
In just two weeks, it has reached the level of the fifth phase. Its limbs have been alienated, its life form has changed, and it has completely transformed into a sinister species. At this point, it can be called a mutated ghoul.
Currently, more than half of the infected people in Yacheng were infected by her. Following this line, Xiao An, Lao Zhang, and I were busy all night and caught more than 20 people! "
Ignoring the water in the sentence "We are killing each other randomly", Wen Wen asked directly: "How to deal with it?"
"According to your rules, Sister Wen, those who have eaten people will be killed. Those who have not yet reached the third stage will be sent to a nursing home. For mandatory treatment, the money will go to the company's account. The specific expenses are here..."
Wen Wen didn't even look at the bills, she just threw them aside casually.
"Anything else?"
"Also, the famous brother you mentioned, ahem, um, the old man Ji Jue said ran to his house and attacked him. The situation has been investigated and is here."
Tong Hua flipped through it for a long time, found two pages, and pushed them over.
A life of lightness.
Chen Lusheng, male, seventy-one years old, a scavenger.
When he was young, he was idle, aggressive and a gangster. He didn't care if his wife ran away with someone else. Later, after my wife died, he finally changed his ways, but it was too late.
Apart from help and manual labor, there was no place for him.
Bricklayers, brick movers, sewer repairs, basically all the trades on the market. After getting older, I saved some money, set up a scrapyard, collected refrigerators and color TVs, and sold them to make ends meet.
This is the ordinary life of a low-level person, without much to say.
Until...he picked up a child in the trash.
She has a hereditary disease, her body is covered with ulcers, and several of her fingers were bitten off by mice. Everyone said that she could not survive. Only the increasingly taciturn old man stayed with her throughout the winter without saying a word.
Got through it.
But it didn't last long.
